spans.text: [10] AR: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍۢ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ EN: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature.

folded.id: that allah|has|made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you his favors
folded.subject: that Allah
folded.object: made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors

spans.text: [20] AR: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَبَاطِنَةًۭ ۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ EN: Do you not see that Allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent?
Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination.

folded.id: the people|is|he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule
folded.subject: the people
folded.object: he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule

spans.text: [6] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ EN: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule.
But of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].

folded.id: then we|will|force them to a massive punishment
folded.subject: then We
folded.object: force them to a massive punishment

spans.text: [24] AR: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًۭا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ EN: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.
[11] AR: هَٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: This is the creation of Allah.
Those will have a humiliating punishment.

folded.id: to allah|belongs|whatever is in the heavens and earth
folded.subject: To Allah
folded.object: whatever is in the heavens and earth

spans.text: [26] AR: لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ EN: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth.

folded.id: to allah|will|be the outcome of [all] matters
folded.subject: to Allah

spans.text: And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters.
Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.
Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did.

folded.id: we|will|follow that upon which we found our fathers
folded.subject: we
folded.object: follow that upon which we found our fathers

spans.text: [21] AR: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers."

[21] AR: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers."

[21] AR: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers."

folded.id: when luqman|said|to his son while he was instructing him
folded.subject: when Luqman
folded.object: to his son while he was instructing him

spans.text: [13] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَٰنُ لِٱبْنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌۭ EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah.

folded.id: while he|is|a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold
folded.subject: while he
folded.object: a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold

spans.text: [22] AR: ۞ وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ EN: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold.
